note.explanation: A website has a front end that users see, a back end that handles behind-the-scenes work, and full-stack development that includes both. HTML structures page content, CSS styles it, and JavaScript adds interactivity. The back end can use web servers, databases, and programming languages such as PHP, Python, and Ruby.
examples: A login form is part of the front end; checking login details and accessing user data are back-end tasks.
A full-stack developer can work on both the login screen and the authentication and database interaction behind it.
note.checkAnswer: JavaScript adds interactivity to web pages.
note.simple: The front end is what users see. The back end does the hidden work. Full-stack development covers both.
note.checkQuestion: Which front-end technology adds interactivity to web pages?
note.title: Basic Components of Web Development
steps: Identify what the user sees and interacts with: this is the front end.
Use HTML to structure the content, CSS to style it, and JavaScript to make it interactive.
Identify the behind-the-scenes work, such as servers, data, and application logic: this is the back end.
A full-stack developer works on both the front end and the back end.

mcqs.stem: Which task is mainly performed by HTML in front-end development?
rationales: Correct: HTML structures content such as headings, paragraphs, images, and links.
Incorrect: CSS styles content, including its colours, fonts, and layout.
Incorrect: JavaScript adds interactivity to web pages.
Incorrect: Databases store and manage data.

mcqs.stem: Which technology is used to style the content on a web page?
rationales: Incorrect: PHP is a back-end programming language.
Correct: CSS styles web-page content, including colours, fonts, and layout.
Incorrect: HTML structures web-page content.
Incorrect: JavaScript adds interactivity to web pages.

mcqs.stem: Which front-end technology can make a web page interactive?
rationales: Correct: JavaScript adds interactivity and can support features such as forms and animations.
Incorrect: A web server stores and delivers web pages to users.
Incorrect: A database stores and manages data.
Incorrect: HTML structures the content on web pages.

options: A computer that stores and delivers web pages
A language used only to style pages
A list of instructions stored in a database
rationales: Correct: A web server stores and delivers web pages when users enter a URL.
Incorrect: Styling web pages is the role of CSS, not a web server.
Incorrect: Creating images is not the definition of a web server.
Incorrect: A database manages data, while a web server delivers web pages.

options: It changes the layout of a page
It delivers a web page when a URL is entered
mcqs.stem: What is the main role of a database in back-end development?
rationales: Correct: Databases store and manage information such as user details and website content.
Incorrect: CSS is used to change page layout.
Incorrect: A login button is part of the user interface, not the database's main role.
Incorrect: A web server delivers web pages to users.

mcqs.stem: Which work is included in full-stack development?
rationales: Incorrect: Full-stack development is not limited to HTML and CSS.
Incorrect: Full-stack development includes more than back-end work.
Correct: Full-stack development includes both the front end and the back end.
Incorrect: Database work is only one possible back-end task.

mcqs.stem: Which of these is identified as a back-end programming language in this section?
rationales: Correct: PHP is given as an example of a back-end programming language.
Incorrect: HTML structures content on web pages.
Incorrect: CSS styles content on web pages.
Incorrect: JavaScript is described here as adding interactivity to web pages.

options: Processing a form on the server
Adding an animation to the page
mcqs.stem: Which is an example of a back-end task?
rationales: Incorrect: Headings are part of the content structured on the front end.
Incorrect: Changing colours is a styling task done with CSS.
Correct: Back-end programming languages can process forms.
Incorrect: An animation is an interactive page feature associated with the front end.

written.text: Login System: A login system is a common feature in web development, allowing users to access their accounts on a website. Explain the roles of front-end, back-end, and full-stack development in this example.
written.finalAnswer: The front end provides the login interface; the back end handles authentication and database interaction; a full-stack developer works on both.

CSS styles the content on web pages by changing colours, fonts, and layout.

explain.title: Front-end development
explain.body: Front-end Development: This focuses on what users see and interact with on a website. HTML structures the content on web pages, like headings, paragraphs, images, and links. CSS styles the content on web pages, changing colors, fonts, and layout to enhance the appearance. JavaScript adds interactivity to web pages, making them dynamic and engaging. It allows features such as forms, animations, and games.

explain.title: Back-end development
explain.body: Back-end Development: This manages the behind-the-scenes functionality of a website, including servers, databases, and application logic. Web Servers are computers that store and deliver web pages to users when they enter a URL. Databases store and manage data, like user information, product details, and website content. Back-end Programming Languages like PHP, Python, and Ruby handle tasks such as processing forms, and managing user logins.

explain.title: Full-stack development
explain.body: A full-stack developer works on both the front end and the back end. In the login-system example, a full-stack developer creates the User Interface (UI) for the front end and handles user authentication and database interaction for the back end.

explain.title: How the parts fit together
explain.body: HTML provides structure, CSS controls appearance, and JavaScript adds interactivity on the front end. The back end handles behind-the-scenes tasks and may use a web server, a database, and a back-end programming language.

mistakes: Do not confuse HTML's role of structuring content with CSS's role of styling it.
Do not say JavaScript is used only to style a page; this section describes it as adding interactivity.
Do not confuse a web server, which delivers web pages, with a database, which stores and manages data.
Do not describe full-stack development as only front-end or only back-end work.
When explaining a login system, identify both the user-facing interface and the behind-the-scenes authentication or database tasks.
